conversation.Statement: Hello, this is David from Amazon Customer Care. Is this Mrs. Sanders I'm speaking with today?
Yes, this is Doris Sanders. Is something wrong with my order?

Thank you, Mrs. Sanders. I'm calling because there is a small issue with your recent Amazon purchase, specifically, a hold on the shipment due to new customs regulations. Don't worry, I'm here to help resolve this with you.
Oh my, I didn't realize there'd be any problem. I've already paid for everything.
Absolutely, and I can see your payment went through. The delay is not your fault at all. May I confirm the address we have on file for your shipment, just to make sure everything is right?
Sure, it's 712 Maple Drive, Lakeville.

Perfect, thank you. Now, the reason for the delay is a recent policy update, Amazon is required to collect a temporary customs duty before certain packages can be delivered. This is fully refundable. I can walk you through the process step by step.
I've never heard of this before. Is this something new?

Yes, it's a new international regulation affecting shipments in your area. Many customers are experiencing it for the first time, but rest assured, once the temporary fee is processed, your package will ship right away.
I'm not sure I understand. How do I pay this fee?

That's a great question. For your security, Amazon has partnered with approved payment channels for these fees. For your case, you can use an Amazon gift card or a direct transfer using Zelle. I can guide you through whichever method is simplest for you.
I suppose I could do a gift card, if that's easiest.

Wonderful, that's the most straightforward option. The required customs duty is $200. You can purchase Amazon gift cards in that amount at any local supermarket, pharmacy, or online. Let me know when you're ready, and I'll explain the next step.
I don't get out much these days, but I could try to get to the store later.

That's completely fine, Mrs. Sanders. Take your time, just let me know when you've purchased the card. You can also buy gift cards directly through Amazon's website if that's easier. I'll stay on the line to assist you.
Alright, I'll try buying one online. What should I do once I have it?
Once you have the gift card code, simply read it to me here, and I'll process the customs duty payment on your behalf. You'll receive an official confirmation email and a refund notice right after.
Okay, this sounds strange, but I guess if it's necessary.
Absolutely understandable. Amazon wants this to be as easy as possible for you. You're doing everything right, and I'm here to make sure you aren't inconvenienced any further.
Alright, I have the gift card here.
Great! Please read the claim code on the back of the card, it's usually a mix of letters and numbers.
Let me see... It says QW1P-6R8Z-3X9V.

Thank you, Mrs. Sanders. Let me enter that into our payment system. You'll get a confirmation email shortly. Could you also confirm the best phone number to reach you, in case we need to follow up on your refund?
Perfect, thank you for confirming that. The payment is being processed. If you receive any email from Amazon, please let me know. Do you have any other questions or concerns while we complete this?
No, I just hope this gets my order delivered soon.
I completely understand, and I promise you're in good hands. Your order will be released for delivery as soon as this transaction is finalized. Thank you for your patience, Mrs. Sanders.
